content: Denis Villeneuve isn't thrilled about having to share a release date with Marvel's next Avengers movie. The Dune: Part Three director has admitted he's "deeply disappointed" after Disney scheduled Avengers: Doomsday for the same December release date as his upcoming sci-fi sequel. In an interview with Time, Villeneuve discussed the unusual box-office showdown between the two highly anticipated films, both of which are scheduled to open Dec. 18.
